Terms

Terms of use

Last updated 6 October 2026. Relay is in private beta. These terms are short on purpose; if something here matters to you, ask us.

What Relay is

Relay is software that joins a group chat to help a group plan a trip together. It collects each traveller’s constraints, proposes options, runs a vote, records the decision and points you at where to book.

What Relay is not

Relay is not a travel agency and is not a seller of travel. It does not hold inventory, does not take payment for flights or accommodation, and does not make a booking on your behalf. When a decision closes, Relay gives you links; you book with the airline, hotel or platform directly, under their terms. Your contract for any travel is with them, not with us.

Prices and availability

Prices and availability that Relay shows come from third parties and move constantly. A price in a Relay message is an indication at the time it was sent, not an offer and not a guarantee. Check the real price before you pay it.

Adding Relay to a group

If you add Relay to a group chat, you confirm that you may do so and that the other members are aware. Relay introduces itself on arrival so nobody is surprised. Any member can ask us to remove their data; the organiser can remove Relay from the chat at any time.

Acceptable use

Don’t use Relay to harass anyone, to impersonate someone, to break the terms of the messaging platform you are on, or to do anything unlawful. We may remove Relay from a group or end access if that happens.

Beta

Relay is early. It will have bugs, it may be unavailable, and features will change or disappear. It is provided as-is, without warranties. Don’t rely on it as the only record of anything that matters.

Liability

To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, for travel you booked, or for decisions your group made. Nothing here limits liability that cannot legally be limited — including for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for fraud.

Price

Relay is free during the private beta. If we start charging, we will tell you before it applies to you.
